units.issue: SEO title limit of 60 characters: the full Russian title with the brand name 'Kairali - The Ayurvedic Healing Village' would exceed the limit, so the brand is shortened to 'Kairali'. The source itself is 71 characters.

units.text: Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village: «Top Ten Wellness Destination in Asia» (National Geographic Traveler), международное признание в области аюрведы.
units.unchangedReason: The brand name 'Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village', the publication name 'National Geographic Traveler' and the quoted award title 'Top Ten Wellness Destination in Asia' are proper names. They are kept in English.
units.issue: SEO description limit of 155 characters: 'recipient of international recognition for Ayurvedic wellness' is condensed to 'международное признание в области аюрведы' to fit (154 characters). The facts are preserved and nothing is added.
